svg.text: The whole first deposit and the first $39,162 of the second buy Treasuries maturing

text.font-family: 'Times New Roman', Tinos, 'Liberation Serif', Times, serif

svg.text: before each January. $36,774 of it covers the $57,070 that early cash might not earn.

svg.text: Half of VT moves into IBTM, whatever the market has done. Laura states her range

text.font-family: 'Times New Roman', Tinos, 'Liberation Serif', Times, serif

svg.text: to co-sponsors only once the Treasuries for it are held. The other half is promised to no one.
